newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD sees 600 mln-reais investment in '97.
newsitem.headline: CVRD sees 600 mln-reais investment in '97.

text.p: Brazilian state mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) plans to invest 600 million reais this year compared with 489 million reais in 1996, according to preliminary company figures.
In a report to Brazil's stock markets, CVRD said it sold 103.16 million tonnes of iron ore and pellets in 1996 and expects to sell 105 million tonnes this year.
Exports of iron ore and pellets, which reached 72.173 million tonnes in 1996, are projected to rise to 74 million tonnes in 1997, the company said.
Internal sales of iron ore reached 30.987 million tonnes in 1996 and are expected to climb to 31 million tonnes in 1997, it said.
Gold sales in 1996 totalled 17.532 tonnes and are expected to rise to an estimated 18 tonnes this year, CVRD said.
The company also said iron ore price talks with Japan have concluded and prices of fine iron ore will rise 1.1 percent while granular iron prices will be maintained.
Price talks with other clients, as well as negotiations over pellet prices, have not been concluded yet, the firm added.
CVRD is the world's largest producer of iron ore. Brazil is South America's largest gold producer.
